concept: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity desktop dashboard art-direction concept for StethoFuse, a cardiopulmonary sound separation research workspace. The attached reference images establish a serene snowy mountain world with translucent frosted glass panels, refined Cormorant Garamond-like serif headings, legible Manrope-like sans UI, pale icy blue, white, ink-blue typography. Preserve that direction but compose a more refined practical dashboard. 1440x1000 landscape. Sidebar240px, slim translucent topbar, quiet snowy landscape visible through the main area. Large serif title 'A clear place to listen, Amina.' Supporting text 'Your recordings, separation runs and reviews, together.' Small honest 'Demo workspace' label. Main composition: wide translucent 'One recording. Distinct components.' feature with elegant fine white signal-ribbon illustration and CTA 'Add a recording'; three modest inline stats5 Recordings,1 Active run,2 Results. Below a spacious glass table 'Recent recordings' with3 realistic fictional rows, and a narrower 'In progress' panel with understated feather artwork. Beautiful thin white rim highlights, gently tinted shadows, subtle backdrop transparency but crisp readable text, softly sculpted blue-gray buttons. No new logo design; reserve original logo space. No giant rounded pills or excessive nested cards. No green theme, no dark-blue backgrounds, no fake clinical scores. This is a visual reference only; preserve all actual app behavior in implementation.
feather: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: isolated decorative cutout for a serene icy-white medical research website. One exquisite snowy owl feather, whole feather visible, gently curved diagonally from lower left quill to upper right tip. White and silver-blue soft barbs with a few restrained natural charcoal-gray markings toward the tip, delicate detailed edges, thin pale rachis. Photorealistic macro product photography, natural tactile feather not plastic, cool soft daylight. Genuinely transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard baked into image, no ground or cast shadow, no text or logo, no owl or other objects. Airy graceful silhouette, generous transparent margins. Supporting decoration only; not intended for the animated owl.
collection: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: wide decorative empty-state artwork for StethoFuse's winter research recording library. A small pair of elegantly frosted translucent glass file folders, one slightly behind the other, on a low soft snowdrift. A very subtle embossed vertical audio waveform symbol centered on the front folder (just5 vertical rounded bars, no text). Fine snow crystals, a tiny snow-laden pine sprig at one side, a few delicate bare winter twigs, pale white and powder-blue palette, natural cool daylight. Premium realistic miniature still-life, not cartoon, not neon, not toyish. Wide composition with the subject centered low, with generous empty margins. Genuinely transparent RGBA background with clean feather-soft snow edges; no checkerboard, no background landscape rectangle, no text, no lettering, no logo, no people, no owl. This will be displayed about300px wide over an icy white webpage. Restrained detail, elegant materials, no gratuitous sparkles.
